description.en: Conflict triage and one-click governance for the DSH plugin page: what is installed, what collides, what is broken, and what each plugin can actually do.
description.zh: DSH 插件页上的冲突体检与一键治理：装了哪些、谁在打架、谁坏了、每个插件到底能干什么。

title.zh: 插件冲突体检与一键治理

description.en: Adds a conflict-clinic tab to Settings → Plugins. Groups duplicate mounts and duplicate modules, flags engine incompatibility and load failures, and offers one-click update / disable conflicting / disable broken / translate descriptions, plus a static capability scan (tools, UI, web routes, subagents, MCP, and more) with file:line evidence.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 插件」页新增冲突体检标签页：把重复挂载与重复装载分组标红，标出引擎不兼容与加载失败，并提供一键更新 / 一键禁用冲突 / 一键禁用报错 / 一键翻译描述，以及带 file:line 证据的能力扫描（工具、UI、Web 接口、子代理、MCP 等）。
